_readme: Real headlines and what the screen should do with them. GitHub checks every one before publishing; if any fail, the screen keeps the last good version. When the screen gets something wrong, add it here with the right answer. 'expect' can include: junk (true = dropped), kept (false = not local, left off the screen), national (true = river only, never the lead), city (true = counts for City Hall), label (the CITY HALL · label), place (yes / other / maybe).
